result:
**Fixed!** The bug was on line 31 of `invoicing/invoice.py`. The `subtotal()` method was using `self.items[:-1]` which excludes the last item from the calculation. I changed it to `self.items` to include all line items.

**All tests pass.** ✓ All 10 tests pass, including the invoice subtotal test that was failing due to this bug.
